title: UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.38043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet

translated_title: UserProxyBench：评估用于智能体基准测试与训练的大语言模型用户模拟器
translated_abstract: 交互式智能体基准测试和多轮强化学习越来越多地将第二个语言模型置于用户的角色。这种模拟用户控制智能体接收什么信息以及何时接收，然而当前的基准测试仅对智能体进行评分，并不直接衡量用户是否正确执行了其被分配的角色。我们提出了UserProxyBench，这是构建在tau-bench系列之上的一个评估层，并引入用户保真度评分（UFS），该评分使用基于任务的评分标准来衡量对基准测试私有用户指令的遵循程度，且独立于智能体的成功与否进行打分。在将智能体固定为GPT-5.5、仅在375个企业任务中更换用户代理的情况下，平均任务奖励变化了15.2分，而24.4%的成功回合中包含用户规范违规。最主要的失败模式是过早披露：用户在信息被请求之前就主动提供了信息。这种行为对任务奖励的影响很小，然而（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了UserProxyBench基准和用户保真度评分（UFS），首次系统评估智能体基准测试中大语言模型用户模拟器是否正确执行其角色，发现更换用户模拟器可使任务奖励变化15.2分、24.4%的成功回合存在用户规范违规，且主要失败模式为信息过早披露。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces UserProxyBench and the User Fidelity Score (UFS) to evaluate whether LLM user simulators in agent benchmarks correctly follow their assigned roles, finding that varying user proxies shifts task reward by 15.2 points, 24.4% of successful episodes contain user-specification violations, and premature disclosure is the dominant failure mode.
